passive_abilities.name: Canticle of Destruction
passive_abilities.description: Whenever a friendly HUNTER CLADE  RUSTSTALKER operative within 3" of this operative is fighting, the first time you strike with a critical success during that sequence, inflict 1 additional damage.

passive_abilities.name: Wasteland Stalker
passive_abilities.description: Whenever an operative is shooting this operative, if you can retain any cover saves, you can retain one additional cover save, or you can retain one cover save as a critical success instead. This isn’t cumulative with improved cover saves from Vantage terrain.

passive_abilities.name: Control Protocol
passive_abilities.description: You can use the Command Override firefight ploy for 0CP if the specified friendly HUNTER CLADE operative is visible to this operative.

passive_abilities.name: Canticle of Shroudpsalm
passive_abilities.description: Whenever a friendly HUNTER CLADE  INFILTRATOR operative is within 3" of this operative, has a Conceal order and is in cover, that friendly operative cannot be selected as a valid target, taking precedence over all other rules (e.g. Seek, Vantage terrain) except being within 2".

passive_abilities.name: Control Protocol
passive_abilities.description: You can use the Command Override firefight ploy for 0CP if the specified friendly HUNTER CLADE operative is visible to this operative.

passive_abilities.name: Canticle of Elimination
passive_abilities.description: Whenever a friendly HUNTER CLADE  RANGER operative is within 3" of this operative, that friendly operative's ranged weapons have the Punishing weapon rule.

passive_abilities.name: Targeting Protocol
passive_abilities.description: Whenever this operative is shooting, if it hasn’t moved during the activation, or if it’s a counteraction, ranged weapons on its datacard have the Lethal 5+ weapon rule. Note this operative isn’t restricted from moving after shooting.

passive_abilities.name: Canticle of the Glow
passive_abilities.description: Whenever an enemy operative is within 3" of this operative, if it's under the effects of the Rad- Saturation rule, also subtract 1 from the Atk stat of that enemy operative’s weapons.

passive_abilities.description: Whenever an enemy operative is within 2" of friendly HUNTER CLADE  VANGUARD operatives, worsen the Hit stat of that enemy operative’s weapons by 1. This isn’t cumulative with being injured.
